title: Anderson–Moore–Vafa twist identity for a pre-modular category
difficulty_reason: The author uses the braid transport to fix a common triple fusion multiplicity space E^r_ijm. Taking determinants of the block double braiding identity turns the three different channel decompositions into products of twist eigenvalues with pairwise fusion multiplicity exponents. Equating determinants and eliminating the common exponents gives the full AMV relation for arbitrary i,j,m,r. This is a new determinant argument over fusion channels; the earlier hexagon expansion and balancing scalar are supplied inputs, and the prior partial trace does not give it.
